note: Repository-wide exceptions per core rule C-27. Each expires; scripts/check-standards.mjs fails on an expired entry until it is renewed or removed. EX-001..EX-005 (pre-standards concatenated JS) were retired by the Phase 3 module migration on 2026-10-08; see docs/PLAN.md.

exceptions.scope: GitHub Actions runners pinned to ubuntu-24.04
exceptions.rationale: Playwright 1.5x cannot install chromium on Ubuntu 26.04; the hub requires versioned runner images with a review note. Review when Playwright supports the latest runner image.
exceptions.removal: Move the pin to the newer image once Playwright supports it; the pin itself stays.
